title: Invoicing & payments Create & Edit gives the edit control on the work order Financial Info card
custom_preconds:
1. A custom role has Work orders View ON, Invoicing & payments Create & Edit ON and See Financial Data ON, but Work orders Create & Edit OFF, with a user assigned.
  2. A work order in an editable (not invoiced, not paid) status exists.

custom_steps_separated.content: Log in as that user and open a work order.
Open the work order detail; the left section shows the Financial Info card.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Financial Info card is shown (See Financial Data is on).

custom_steps_separated.content: Find the edit (pencil) control on the Financial Info card.
custom_steps_separated.expected: The edit control is shown and usable, because Invoicing & payments Create & Edit grants it even without Work orders Create & Edit.

viu_status: Blocked-UI: on an open WO the Financial Info card shows an edit affordance, but the same generic WO-header edit affordance appears for BOTH an invoicing-C&E role and a WO-C&E-only (no invoicing) role — the invoicing-specific Financial Info edit control could not be isolated from general WO-edit affordances in the harness. Needs a real browser to confirm the invoicing-gated edit control specifically.
